THE ONE THING TO UNDERSTAND FIRST
TornX predicts the next distinct market state, not a price exactly X hours from now.
A distinct state is a new price configuration across Torn's 35 stocks. The prediction window estimates when the next meaningful state change is expected, while each stock row estimates where that stock may be when that state arrives.
QUICK START: HOW TO USE TORNX
01 Check the predicted change window. This is when TornX expects the current market state to resolve into the next one.
02 Read the stock row. Predicted price is the estimated next-state price. Current is the latest price synced by TornX and may briefly differ from Torn due to refresh timing. Forecast shows the expected move between them.
03 Use the signal now. A BUY signal is not telling you to wait until the timer ends. The timer is the expected resolution window, not an entry countdown.
04 Re-check at the next window. The next prediction can update the target and signal. A predicted price is an estimate for that state, not a permanent take-profit order.
WHAT THE SIGNALS MEAN
BUY TornX expects the stock to be higher in the next predicted state.
SELL / AVOID TornX expects a lower next-state price. If you own it, this is an exit warning. If you do not, it means avoid entering.
HOLD No actionable directional move is currently being recommended.
FEE-CLEARED The predicted edge is large enough to clear Torn's 0.1% selling fee. Torn does not charge a buying fee here. If it says Below fee edge, the direction may still be predicted correctly, but the expected move is too small to justify as a fee-cleared trade.
SELECTIVE TIER: PREDICT vs ABSTAIN
You do not need to select a tier. The Selective tier is TornX's stricter high-confidence layer.
PREDICT means the stricter conditions currently qualify. ABSTAIN means TornX refuses to issue a high-confidence Selective call right now. It does not mean every stock has no forecast, and it is not an error.
Important: Selective accuracy figures apply only to the rare events where the Selective gate qualifies. They are not a blanket accuracy percentage for every stock or every prediction window.
THE MOST COMMON MISUNDERSTANDING
If TornX says a stock is expected to reach a higher price around tomorrow's window, that does not mean it must touch that exact price at an exact second. It means TornX expects the next distinct market state around that window to place the stock near the predicted level.

Because of that, judging a prediction several hours before its window is reached tells you very little. Evaluate it after the predicted state has had time to occur, then continue across multiple windows.
COMMON QUESTIONS, ANSWERED
When do I sell after a BUY?
Re-check the stock when TornX produces the next prediction. The target can move and the signal can change. SELL / AVOID is the exit warning; the predicted price itself is not a fixed take-profit order.
Why can a stock say BUY but also Below fee edge?
BUY describes the predicted direction. Fee-cleared answers a different question: whether the expected move is large enough to clear Torn's 0.1% selling fee. Use the Fee-cleared filter when you only want signals that pass that check.
Does TornX aim for a fixed percentage of profit per trade?
No. TornX predicts the next market state and the expected movement for each stock. It does not target or promise a fixed return per trade. If you have your own minimum profit threshold, use the forecast and fee-cleared status to decide whether the expected move is large enough for you.
Is Signal Strength the probability the prediction is correct?
No. Signal Strength is a relative move-strength indicator. It is not a per-stock accuracy percentage and should not be confused with the separate Selective-tier validation figures.
HOW TO TEST TORNX PROPERLY
The 7-day trial exists so you can judge TornX from predictions made before the outcome is known. Follow several prediction → window → outcome cycles instead of judging one quiet period or one stock.

Personal portfolio returns are not predictor accuracy; they also depend on capital, position sizing, which signals you act on, timing and execution. The clean comparison is: what TornX predicted vs what the market actually did.
The short version
Signal tells you what TornX expects. Prediction window tells you roughly when to evaluate it. Fee-cleared tells you whether the expected move clears the selling fee.
